items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So they hired old Neil Spencer. ... No, but he had been with Kirby, John Kirby and all that, you know. His name was much -- no-one knew who I was.

ctx.x: It was wonderful. And we were just getting to be a family, and Joe Glazer said, 'You've got to get Kenny Clarke out of there. He has no -- who knows Kenny Clarke?' So Pops said, 'Leave the kid alone. Leave the kid alone.
He'll be all right." Glazer said, "No, Pops. We've got to have a name there." You know, because after Big Sid, you know, and then here I come. I'm nobody, you know. So they hired old Neil Spencer.
That's a shame when a manager puts his two cents in, isn't it?
